vyzhimka.tekst:
Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions, LLC is a Tampa, Florida-based financial-services business. Florida corporate records show it was formed in November 2021 and remains active as of its 2026 annual filing. Julia Dospehoff is listed as the company’s manager and registered agent. ([search.sunbiz.org](https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/GetDocument?aggregateId=flal-l21000488130-2e624945-25aa-449f-880a-4bfffb23ecbb&formatType=PDF&transactionId=l21000488130-a17b9744-6e6b-4621-89f9-f0f2d6471403&utm_source=openai))

The company appears to provide outsourced or “fractional” CFO and accounting support. In this model, a business gets financial-management expertise without employing a full-time CFO internally. Based on the company name and available business listings, that would generally involve functions such as bookkeeping/accounting oversight, financial reporting and analysis, cash-flow management, budgeting/forecasting, and higher-level financial guidance for business owners. Public search results associate Julia Dospehoff specifically with Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions and include recommendations describing her as detail-oriented, knowledgeable, responsive, and professional. ([alignable.com](https://www.alignable.com/temple-terrace-fl/jules-creative-llc?utm_source=openai))

One caveat: I’m finding solid Florida registration information but relatively little first-party information about the firm’s exact service menu. So I would not assume that every typical fractional-CFO service above is necessarily offered by this particular company.

If you’re researching them because of a job opportunity, potential engagement, or a charge/invoice you received, I can also dig further into the company’s website, Julia Dospehoff’s professional background, reviews, and whether the business appears legitimate.
